description: This file defines an abstract class 'Smarty_Internal_Data' that serves as a core component of the Smarty templating system, handling template variables, configuration, and extension management.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Data
classes.description: An abstract class foundational to Smarty's internal data management, handling template variables, configuration, extension methods, and dynamic method calls.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns one or multiple template variables to the data object, supporting chaining.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends values to existing template variables through the extension handler.

methods.name: assignGlobal
methods.description: Assigns a global Smarty variable via the extension handler.

methods.name: getTemplateVars
methods.description: Retrieves a template variable or all variables.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Deprecated: retrieves the object of a Smarty template variable.

methods.name: _mergeVars
methods.description: Merges template and config variables from parent and self.

methods.name: _isDataObj
methods.description: Checks if the object is of Data type.

methods.name: _isTplObj
methods.description: Checks if the object is a template.

methods.name: _isSmartyObj
methods.description: Checks if the object is a Smarty object.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined methods dynamically via extension.
